display_name: Zerodha Broking Ltd (retail tariff, as published on its own charges page)
description: Broker-specific charges only. Statutory and exchange charges live in config/costs/statutory_charges.json. Another broker is a new file in this folder with the same shape.
model_assumptions: Each option leg is one executed order, so a two-leg spread costs 2 brokerage charges to enter and 2 to exit. Whether a broker bills a basket or a partially filled order differently is not modelled.
The paper account is funded: no debit-balance surcharge unless account_in_debit is set.

option_brokerage.unit: brokerage per executed order for options

versions.notes: Zerodha: 'Flat Rs. 20 per executed order' for F&O options. Brokerage is also charged on expired, exercised and assigned contracts. Start date of the current tariff not verified.

debit_balance_surcharge.unit: extra charge per executed order when the account has a debit balance

versions.notes: Zerodha: 'Accounts with a debit balance will be charged an additional Rs 20 per executed order.'
